items.title: Digital twin platform for network-level predictive bridge condition assessment and management for disaster risk reduction: integrating AI and data standards
items.text: Started May 2026. Builds the Bridge Intelligence pipeline end to end on a pilot bridge, from UAV and LiDAR survey to network-level prioritization, with data standards owner agencies can adopt.

items.title: Damage detection and assessment system for coastal concrete bridge structures using engineering innovation
items.text: Completed. Combined UAV imagery, AI damage detection and finite-element assessment for reinforced-concrete bridges in a marine environment.

items.title: Early-warning system for infrastructure deformation using InSAR
items.text: With the Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand. Satellite InSAR monitoring of deformation in critical infrastructure, led by the Geospatial and Field Operations group.

items.title: UAV and AI technologies for infrastructure: professional training course
items.text: Curriculum approved by the Thailand Board of Investment. First cohort will run once budget is allocated; open to engineers from government agencies and industry.
